name: Youtou Jiken
source:
Takumi happens to find a stabbed corpse on the backstreet. A sword is stabbed.... When he touches it, the sword goes into his palm, and he sees the images that the corpse saw when it just died. Takumi runs away from it.... On the next day, there is news about the murder case.... He already gets involved in this case....

[From ErogeShop]
